Protein Group

Nuts & Seeds

About This Group

Tree nuts and oilseeds bring concentrated fat and protein to the plate, from almonds to pine nuts, each with its own roasted, buttery, or earthy character.

Nuts and seeds add fat and texture — almonds to chia. Richness invites oxidative whites, sherry styles, and off-dry pairings.

FAQ

Why are plant foods not organized by cuts?
Botanical structure uses plant_part and edible_structure — not steak or roast primals.
How does bone_state apply to plants?
not_applicable — bone metadata is reserved for animal protein foods.
